register_signal_handlers: register signal handlers for SIGTERM and SIGUSR1 to handle SLURM auto-requeue and graceful shutdown
teardown_signal_handlers: teardown and restore original signal handlers that were replaced by SignalConnector
compose_signal_handlers: compose multiple signal handlers into a single callable that invokes each handler in sequence
handle_slurm_sigusr: handle SLURM SIGUSR signal by saving checkpoint and requeuing the job via scontrol
get_valid_signals: get all valid signals supported on the current platform with Python 3.8+ and Windows fallback
